text: Failed to build iOS app on Xcode 16 is rarely your Dart code. Upgrade Flutter, raise Podfile to iOS 13, wipe Pods and ~/Library DerivedData, then pod install.
.NET 10 SDK now prunes runtime-shipped NuGet packages out of the restore graph by default. 70% fewer ghost CVEs, restore up to 50% faster.
Task.Run is just StartNew with safe defaults. Use it for nearly all work; QueueUserWorkItem<TState> only for zero-alloc cases.
